title: Does Privacy Matter? Evidence from a Legal Reform
authors: Liran Einav; Ehud Guttel; Ilan Kremer; Guy Lakan; Sarit Weisburd
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. One legal reform (plaintiff anonymity, implemented August 2015; post defined by claim close date) affecting personal-injury claims (claim_type==1) with property-damage claims as controls: areg ln_payment_adjust 1.claim_type#1.post i.claim_type controls i.year_grp i.firm, absorb(city_stat) on a repeated cross-section of claims. The csdid in Figure A5 assigns a single cohort (tyear = 8 for all personal-injury claims), so it is a two-group design.
design_notes: Universe of disputed car-accident insurance claims closed 2011-2020 at the five major Israeli insurers (Combined_Clean_Cars.dta), merged with CBS statistical-area demographics, Dun's 100 law firms, CPI and wage indices. Table 2 DiD (claim_type x post) with claimant controls, statistical-area FE, insurer FE, year-group FE; Table 3 triple differences by claimant groups; Table 4 robustness (alternative post dates, windows); event studies by half-year (Figure 3) and csdid (Figure A5).
estimators_reported: Callaway-Sant'Anna csdid (single cohort, appendix Figure A5)
modern_estimators_named: Callaway-Sant'Anna (csdid drimp, appendix Figure A5, single cohort)
data_files: No data shipped (Israeli Capital Markets Authority insurer data under agreement); logs/*.log contain regression output
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README.pdf, master.do, Analysis/*.do).
